cover: Strike hits Nasser Medical Complex; nine killed
129 websites blocked on forged court orders

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: A strike at a medical complex
bullets: Four were killed in a strike at Nasser Medical Complex, civil defence said.
Two brothers died in a tent in Sheikh Radwan.
No Israeli military comment was reported.

stories.label: World · Livelihood
stories.head: A war that empties pockets
bullets: A UN survey of 23,736 households in all 18 states.
83% of displaced families have unmet livelihood needs.

stories.label: India · Expression
stories.head: Blocked on forged court orders
bullets: The telecom department relied on two forged High Court orders, Reuters reported.
Police registered an FIR after the Allahabad High Court complained.
The department did not respond to Reuters.

stories.label: World · Detention
stories.head: Held for opposing military rule
bullets: More than 32,000 arrested for opposing military rule, HRW says.
At least 2,300 reportedly died in custody.
